title: Rusting experiment with three bottles
body: A class performs an experiment on iron nails. They scrub three iron nails with sandpaper until they shine and tie each with a thread. Bottle A: one nail is placed with some silica gel and the bottle is tightly capped. Silica gel keeps the air inside dry. Bottle B: one nail is placed and freshly boiled and cooled water is poured until the nail is completely dipped. A layer of oil is then poured over the water and the bottle is tightly capped. Bottle C: one nail is placed and some water is poured so that the nail is only partly dipped. The bottle is left open. All three bottles are kept undisturbed at room temperature and observed for 8 to 10 days.
